events.text: London's Metropolitan Police make their first patrols.
Italy declares war on the Ottoman Empire.
John D. Rockefeller becomes the world's first billionaire.
Allied forces break through the Hindenburg Line in the First World War.
The British Mandate for Palestine takes effect.
CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, is established.
The Kyshtym nuclear disaster occurs at the Mayak plant in the Soviet Union.
Space Shuttle Discovery launches, NASA's first crewed mission since the Challenger disaster.
